name: frisch-2012-zooplankton.pdf
description: Frisch et al. (2012) PLoS ONE study tracking zooplankton (copepods, cladocerans, rotifers) colonizing 48 newly built temporary ponds in a restored Doñana National Park wetland over 21 months, finding that connectivity, pond area, and spatial position drove colonization for copepods and cladocerans but not rotifers.
